name: @playform/hook-dsh-workspace-monitor
description: The workspace-monitor hook: a DeepSeek Harness plugin that plays the workspace family's watch/sweep role - the wave-3 machinery with NO REAL TIMERS. The watch form: on every fs/observed event (heard on the ROOT context, the factory's Wire registration) it records one watch entry (the path, the observed version, the clock stamp, the classified check sets) with a debounce deadline computed from the module's Clock. The sweep form: a CLOCK-BASED SCHEDULE - the sweep is a deadline scan that runs inside the event-driven checkpoints (every fs/observed event, plus the deadline-elapsed entries), never a setTimeout or setInterval: an entry whose debounce elapsed since its last sweep is swept, its next deadline is recomputed from the Clock, and the health/performance counters (events observed, sweeps run, last sweep stamp) advance. The check sets: a shipped classification catalog (tsc, format, cargo, governance - the live-containers monitor precedent) maps a watched path to its check-set identifiers; the monitor classifies and ledgered-records, it NEVER executes a command (the check execution stays with the live-containers monitor; this hook owns the watch state and the accountability). Every decision carries a byte-stable module-owned ledger line. The plugin ships DISABLED - the IDLE-forever posture. Plan: Documentation/Plans/Workspace-Family/MONITOR.md + Documentation/Plans/WORKSPACE-PLUGIN-FAMILY-DECOMPOSITION.md (the monitor role).
